name: fillet-overlaps-a-hole
why: The hole 0.5 mm into the fillet's foot (x = 5.5). OpenCASCADE's cut-then-fillet rolls the ball along the rim between the two crossings and roofs the hole (15 faces, 7303.151 mm³ before the reorder); ParCAD builds the fillet before the cut and cuts the hole through it, so the hole stays through: 13 faces, like the clear part, and a little more material than the roofed result. The control for fillet-ends-on-a-hole-rim on the far side.
